newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Endemol says Holiday on Ice disappoints.
newsitem.headline: Endemol says Holiday on Ice disappoints.

text.p: Dutch television production group Endemol said on Tuesday that its acquisition of Holiday on Ice had boosted turnover at its Live Entertainment division, but that profits had lagged expectations.
"The net result of Holiday on Ice is disappointing due to declining demand for live entertainment, particularly in the German and French markets," Endemol said in a statement.
Endemol acquired Holiday on Ice in the second half of its 1995/96 fiscal year ended July 31.
Endemol earlier reported first-half 1996/97 net profit up 19 percent at 33.7 million guilders.
By contrast Endemol's production of the Miss Saigon musical drew capacity audiences and results had exceeded expectations.
"This success is only partially reflected in the half-year figures because the first performance was staged three months after the start of the fiscal year," Endemol said.
The results of a 50-50 joint venture signed with U.S. theatre producer Dodger Productions early this year would be incorporated in the results from the second half onwards, it added.
